newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia palm oil ends down ahead of crop report.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia palm oil ends down ahead of crop report.

text.p: PALMOIL FUTURES PALMOIL PHYSICALS
Jan (3rd pos) 1,157 rgt/tonne Nov (south) 1,172.50 *
Open/hi/low 1,171/1,174/1,156 Prev close 1,180
Prev settlement 1,171 * sellers prices
PALM OIL FUTURES - Prices ended lower on liquidation ahead of private forecaster Ivan Wong's crop report, expected on Thursday. Immediate support for Jan seen at 1,150 with resistance at 1,180.
PALM OIL PHYSICALS - Prices also eased with refiners seen selling back into the market after recent covering. Trading remains thin as export demand slows.
Traders said selling by refiners aggravated the fall.
Third position January crude palm oil futures ended down 14 ringgit at 1,157 ringgit ($458.22) a tonne. Traders pegged immediate support at 1,150 with resistance seen at 1,180.
Volume on the futures market totalled 1,463 lots against 1,423 lots on Tuesday.
Physicals prices also eased as refiners sold back into the market after recent covering, traders said. Lack of fresh export business also weighed on prices, they said.
Nov (south) crude palm oil was offered at 1,172.50 ringgit ($464.36) a tonne with bids at 1,167.50, after trading from 1,177.50 to 1,170.
Nov (central) was offered at 1,157.50 with bids at 1,150, and traded from 1,167.50 to 1,155.
Nov (north) saw offers at 1,150 and bids at 1,145.
Dec (south) was offered at 1,180 ringgit with bids at 1,170. It was traded from 1,185 to 1,175.
Dec (central) saw offers at 1,167.50 and bids at 1,157.50.
Among refined products, Nov RBD palm olein was offered at $535 a tonne FOB Malaysia, Dec at $530 and Jan/Feb/Mar at $532.50. Nov was traded at $535, Dec at $530 and jan/feb/Mar at $532.50.
Nov/Dec RBD palm oil was offered at $497.50 and Jan/Feb/Mar at $500. Nov was done at $500 and $497.50.
Nov RBD palm stearin saw sellers at $370 and Dec at $372.50.
Nov/Dec palm fatty acid distillate was offered at $310.
